div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
SecurityConfig — 3 цепочки:
№0 /internal/** → X-Internal-API-Key (fail-closed)
№1 /actuator/** permitAll (chaosmonkey — ADMIN)
№2 /api/v1/** → JWT: JwtAuthenticationFilter →
AuthPrincipal → RBAC (USER/ADMIN) →
ownership @authz.ownerOrAdmin(userId)

(сага): по k8s DNS,

второй контур: X-Internal-API-Key
